Name: E01
Line: (The elevator doors open. Light. Confetti. Applause.)

Name: E02
Speaker: PA
Line: That's a wrap on Employee {EMP}! That's a wrap on Employee {EMP}!

Name: E03
Speaker: Coworker
Line: You were incredible. We're so proud of you.

Name: E04
Line: (The clock on the wall still reads 2:14.)

Name: E05
Speaker: The Collector
Line: Congratulations, {EMP}. Really. Not many make it to the end of the take.

Name: E06
Speaker: The Collector
Line: The Chairman watched every second. He thinks you've earned your director's cut.

Name: E07
Speaker: The Collector
Line: Sign off on this one and you never do another take. Same desk. Same mug. The perfect day, forever. That's the theatrical cut.

Name: E08
Speaker: The Collector
Line: You just have to hand over your keys.

Name: E09
Line: HAND OVER YOUR KEYS?   [ YES ]   [ NO ]

Name: E10
Speaker: The Collector
Line: Wonderful. Places, everyone. From the top.

Name: E11
Line: (Somewhere, a new badge is printed. It has your face. It says 4472.)

Name: E13
Speaker: The Collector
Line: Of course. Of course. Take your time.

Name: E14
Line: (The passes are no longer on your badge. You never felt them go.)

Name: E15
Line: (For three seconds: the uncut footage. The real office. Empty desks. A long line of badges on hooks, each with a number.)

Name: E17
Line: (Soul Sight flickers on the Collector. Code starts to resolve. Cut to black.)
